+import {
+  Flex,

+} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
+import React, { useState } from 'react';
+import type { RealTheme } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
+import { Overview } from './pages/Overview';
+import { Projects } from './pages/Projects';
+import { Settings } from './pages/Settings';
+import type { PageId } from './types';
+import './styles/app.css';
+
+const navigationItems = [
+  { id: 'overview', title: 'Обзор' },
+  { id: 'projects', title: 'Проекты' },
+  { id: 'settings', title: 'Настройки' },
+];

+export function App() {
+  const [page, setPage] = useState<PageId>('overview');
+  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<RealTheme>('light');
+  const themeMode = theme.endsWith('-hc') ? theme.slice(0, -3) : theme;
+
+  return (
+    <Flex direction=\"column\" className=\"app\" gap=\"6\">
+      <header className=\"app__header\">
+        <Flex className=\"app__content\" direction=\"column\" gap=\"4\" spacing={{ py: 5, px: 4 }}>

+              Рабочая панель
+            </Text>
+            <SegmentedRadioGroup
+              size=\"m\"
+              value={themeMode}
+              onUpdate={(value) => {
+                setTheme(value === 'dark' && theme.endsWith('-hc') ? 'dark-hc' : value);
+              }}
+            >
+              <SegmentedRadioGroup.Option value=\"light\">Светлая</SegmentedRadioGroup.Option>
+              <SegmentedRadioGroup.Option value=\"dark\">Тёмная</SegmentedRadioGroup.Option>
+            </SegmentedRadioGroup>
+          </Flex>
+
+          <TabProvider value={page} onUpdate={(value) => setPage(value as PageId)}>
+            <TabList size=\"m\">
+              {navigationItems.map((item) => (
+                <Tab key={item.id} value={item.id}>
+                  {item.title}
+                </Tab>
+              ))}
+            </TabList>
+          </TabProvider>
+        </Flex>
+      </header>
+
+      <main className=\"app__content\" style={{ padding: 'var(--g-spacing-xl)' }}>
+        {page === 'overview' && <Overview />}
+        {page === 'projects' && <Projects />}
+        {page === 'settings' && <Settings theme={theme} onThemeChange={setTheme} />}
+      </main>
+    </Flex>
+  );
+}
